picks.name: Soul Clap
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Freerange Records. Extremely dry research day (50+ searches across labels and artists, with two year-confusion false positives caught: Branko's "OBG" turned out to be 2022, Forest Drive West's "Mantis 1920" was already published in August). Exact Bandcamp release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link uses the label's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Drowning In Your Love" (January 30, 2026, Freerange) is Soul Clap's first release for the label -- a five-track EP featuring Shaun J. Wright on vocals, pairing a deep, funk-inflected house title track with two versions of "EFUNK Anthem."
picks.why_listen: Classic Chicago-rooted house/funk songwriting from a duo with deep genre pedigree -- warm, vocal-led material for a groove-forward stretch of a set.
